october2026PerformanceDrafts.plainEnglish: In October, about 262 visits to the website and 62 clicks from Google Search. Search visibility stayed active with about 1,850 impressions. Tracked conversions in analytics were zero for the month.
october2026PerformanceDrafts.versusSeptember: Website visits down about 14% versus September. Search clicks down about 36% versus September. Search impressions were about flat. Average search position moved slightly (about 8.4 in October vs 8.4 in September).
limitations: Figures are from synced Google analytics and Search Console, not a live Google dashboard.
Small sites can swing month to month; one month is not a trend.
Analytics conversions are not the same as confirmed customer inquiries or sales.
recommendations: Continue Search Console monitoring already recorded as in-progress work.
Review which pages earn the most search clicks before making content changes.
Founder review before publishing an October client report in the portal.

october2026PerformanceDrafts.plainEnglish: October search data shows about 41 clicks from Google and about 2,755 search impressions for the live On Track Performance site. Website visit counts were not available in the synced October facts.
october2026PerformanceDrafts.versusSeptember: Search clicks down about 21% versus September. Impressions down about 15% versus September.
limitations: October reporting_facts include Search Console only for this client; GA4 website visit metrics were not present for comparison.
The replacement website remains staged, not launched; this data reflects the current live site.
recommendations: Keep indexing follow-through on the live site (in-progress deliverable).
Schedule a separate review of the staged replacement site when Don is ready.
Founder review before publishing an October client report.

october2026PerformanceDrafts.plainEnglish: October was the first full month with Google Analytics verified on the live Townsgate site (installed 2026-09-28). About 40 visits, 70 page views, and 17 search clicks. Tracked conversions were zero.
october2026PerformanceDrafts.versusSeptember: Website visits up about 700% versus September after GA4 went live (September had only a handful of tracked visits). Search clicks up about 55% versus September.
limitations: September website visit numbers were pre-GA4 and are not comparable to October.
Search and visit volumes are still modest for a multi-tenant property site.
recommendations: Use October as a baseline month going forward; avoid overstating growth from the install transition.
Founder review before publishing an October client report.

october2026PerformanceDrafts.plainEnglish: In October the live OTP Carts site had about 87 visits and 257 page views. Google Search sent about 9 clicks. Analytics recorded one website lead event for the month. That is an analytics signal, not a confirmed sale.
october2026PerformanceDrafts.versusSeptember: Website visits up about 24% versus September. Search clicks up about 80% versus September. Average search position improved from about 14.8 to about 10.0 in Search Console aggregates.
limitations: The lead event is from analytics tagging, not a validated CRM or sale record.
Social account setup in October (work #49–50) is separate from these website metrics.

recommendations: Complete Westlake profile verification so local search work can finish.
